name: Eazily Chat
author: eazily

sections.description:
Eazily Chat adds your AI assistant to any WordPress site as a floating chat bubble. Your visitors can ask questions, get recommendations, and book appointments — all powered by your Eazily assistant.

Features:

  • One-click installation — just enter your Assistant ID
  • Floating chat button that works on all pages
  • Customizable position (bottom-right or bottom-left)
  • Custom brand color for the chat button
  • Mobile responsive
  • No impact on page load speed (loads asynchronously)

Privacy

Eazily Chat loads an external script from Eazily servers to provide the chat functionality.

This may send the following data to Eazily:
– Page URL
– User interactions with the chat widget
– Messages entered into the chat

This data is used solely to provide and improve the AI assistant experience.

For more information, see: https://eazily.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to Settings > Eazily Chat.
  6. Enter your Assistant ID (found in your Eazily dashboard).
  7. Click “Save Changes”. The chat widget will appear on your site immediately.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Assistant ID?

Log in to your Eazily dashboard, open your assistant’s settings, and copy the ID shown in the embed section.

Can I customize the chat button color?

Yes. Enter a hex color code (like #5B4CD8) in the Primary Color field under Settings > Eazily Chat.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The widget script loads asynchronously and does not block page rendering.
